Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 204/2015 dated 19.03.2015 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Bawana.

The quashing petition is based on a settlement dated 21.11.2022 before the Delhi Mediation Centre,
Rohini District Court.

entities.text:
Delhi Mediation Centre,
Rohini District Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is present in Court and is identified by Mr. H.P. Sharma, Adv.
Respondent No. 2 is also present and is identified by Mr. Roushan Kumar, Adv. and IO SI Rahul, PS Bawana.
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will, without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.
Respondent No. 2 states that she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.
There is minor child born out of the wedlock, who is in the care and custody of petitioner No. 1.
Since the custody of the minor child is with petitioner No. 1, respondent No. 2 shall have unfettered and unhindered rights to visit the minor child as and when she wants.
